summary.headline: Infirmities and Marriage
summary.text: Astrological rules for bodily infirmities, distinguishing diseases by planetary dryness, oriental or occidental position, and angular houses, and interpreting the ascendant, Moon, and their lords as significators of body and soul. The page then opens Chapter XXV on marriage, its causes, and the significations of the seventh house.
